create.title: Hard-TOP t=1 residual K17a primitive-conductor parity self-return
create.statement_tex: Within the accepted low-cross-gcd high-reduced-conductor K17a packet, define K_q(b)=sum_((a,q)=1)c_q(a)e(ab/q) and K_q^circ(b)=K_q(b)-mu(q)/q. For odd q, K_q(b)=q^(-1)sum_(d|q)mu(q/d)d E_d(b), and for b in U(q), K_q(b)+K_q(-b)=2mu(q)/q, with the entire symmetric term coming from d=1. The exact-q two-orientation block is the centered defect (q/u_0)sum_b K_q^circ(b)(B^+_(q,b)-B^-_(q,b)) plus the symmetric trace (mu(q)/u_0)sum_b(B^+_(q,b)+B^-_(q,b)); the complete q>Q_B trace is O_(B,delta,gamma,epsilon)(L X^epsilon) after q|u_0 and u_0|u summation. For every odd u_0>1 and b in U(u_0), sum_(q|u_0)(q/u_0)K_q^circ(b)=E_(u_0)(b), while K_1^circ=0. Hence the high-conductor centered defect equals the original literal orientation block minus the already-safe low-conductor packet, and the all-conductor centered traces cancel with q=1 essential. This is exact self-return, not an estimate. Prime and prime-square artificial buckets show coefficient-uniform Lq capacity without literal lower mass. The fixed-modulus reflection fails the complete live displacement and endpoint/selector domain, while the endpoint-preserving exchange changes the fixed row and sends selected divisors to zero-extended complements. The literal high-q estimate (177.K34), complete K17a, every parent, bridge, theorem, and exponent remain open.
